title: 第17章 你能接我一剑此泉归你第18章 冲击王境紫红雷劫
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 王傅张了张嘴，神色中充斥着难以置信。
不仅是对王焱会出现在这里而感到难以置信，更是对王焱为何会出现在……这飞舟之上的震惊。
不止是王焱，在飞舟甲板之上，他还看到了另外几道熟悉的身影，李元、自己未来的儿媳妇李红……
飞舟上的几人，自然便是林玄几人了。
从临月城出发后，王焱便是将他心中的担忧，告诉了林玄，得知后林玄一路飞来时，特地将自己的神识外放。
这不，刚进入映月山脉内部没多久，便发现了王焱父亲的踪迹。
这才有刚才那飞射而来的一剑。
林玄也是有些感慨，得亏是自己神识提前感应到了，要是再晚一步，只怕……
秦刚等人看了一眼王傅，又看了一眼飞舟上的王焱，陷入了无边错愕之中。
王傅老哥，居然认识那飞舟上的尊贵之人？
不，何止是认识那么简单。
可是，这一路上在和王傅的交谈中得知，王傅不过是来自唐清帝国边隅的一座小城，族内最强的也不到劫境，怎么会和王境强者扯上关系？
若真有这关系，王傅也不至于沦落到跟他们一路啊……
很快，王焱便跳下了飞舟，和王傅攀谈到了一起。
静静看着二人，林玄并未催促。
“焱儿，这位前辈是……”
王傅终于是将心中最疑惑的事问了出口。
目光则是同时看向那甲板最前方，俊逸非凡的白衣剑修。
“爹，我来介绍一下，这位是我师尊。”
闻言，林玄也是朝王傅点了点头，面带笑意。
倒是王傅，被林玄这一丝笑意搞得有些受宠若惊，赶忙抱拳回礼。
“王傅，见过前辈。”
也不怪他会这般。
王境强者，这根本不是他所能接触到的存在，虽然见过，但还从未和哪位王境强者搭过话，也从未有任何王境强者正眼看过他，对于那等存在而言，连劫境都是蝼蚁般的存在，更何况他才区区天玄。
“无需这般，你既是王焱的父亲，便是自己人，上来吧。”林玄邀请道。
就这样，王傅带着几位同样处于震惊中的王家之人，上了飞舟。
“你们也上来吧。”
正当秦汉等一众冒险团之人面露羡慕时，林玄的声音再次传来。
“啊？多，多谢前辈！多谢前辈！”
收了云梭鸟的尸体后，飞舟再次驭空而去，朝焚天山脉的方向极速掠去。
林玄已经继续回房闭关，他能感觉到，自己距离领悟最后一条大道，已经近在咫尺了！
而王傅王焱等人，则是位于甲板之上，望着那不断倒退的景色，心中感慨不已。
何曾几时，他们于山脉之中寸步难行，无时无刻不在担惊受怕，晚上睡觉都睡不安稳，稍有动静便紧张的不行。
再看如今……
一柄悬浮于飞舟上方的长剑，散发着极其恐怖的剑意，正是这股剑意，使得飞舟一路上畅通无阻，但凡妖兽，无不避之大吉，惊恐的望着飞舟从它们头顶上空飞掠而过。
这是以往，王傅秦刚等一众冒险团成员想都不敢想的。
下方随便一头妖兽，此前他们遇到都得躲着走，生怕招惹到对方。
如今？
直接从对方头顶上飞过，对方也不敢有丝毫异动。
令人唏嘘。
危机四伏的映月山脉内部，如今却仿佛飞舟的后花园一般。
“王傅老哥，沾了你的光，我老秦也有幸坐了一把王级飞舟，哈哈哈……”秦刚也有些感慨。
两日后，飞舟抵达焚天
content_en:
Wang Fu opened his mouth, his expression filled with disbelief.
Not only was it unbelievable that Wang Yan would appear here, but he was also shocked as to why Wang Yan would appear... on this flying boat.
Not only Wang Yan, he also saw several other familiar figures on the deck of the flying boat, Li Yuan, his future daughter-in-law Li Hong...
The few people on the flying boat were naturally Lin Xuan and others.
After setting off from Linyue City, Wang Yan told Lin Xuan his worries. After learning that Lin Xuan flew all the way, he deliberately released his consciousness.
No, not long after entering the Yingyue Mountain Range, traces of Wang Yan's father were discovered.
Only then did the flying sword come from just now.
Lin Xuan also felt a little emotional. Fortunately, his spiritual consciousness sensed it in advance. If it had been a step later, I'm afraid...
Qin Gang and others glanced at Wang Fu, then at Wang Yan on the flying boat, and fell into boundless astonishment.
Brother Wang Fu actually knows the noble person on the flying boat?
No, it's more than just understanding.
However, during the conversation with Wang Fu along the way, I learned that Wang Fu was just from a small city on the edge of the Tang and Qing Empire, and the strongest member of the clan was not even in the Tribulation Realm. How could he be related to a strong King Realm?
If there really is such a relationship, Wang Fu will not be reduced to being with them...
Soon, Wang Yan jumped off the flying boat and talked with Wang Fupan.
Looking at the two of them quietly, Lin Xuan did not urge them.
"Yan'er, this senior is..."
Wang Fu finally asked the question that was most doubtful in his heart.
At the same time, his eyes were looking at the extremely handsome swordsman in white at the front of the deck.
"Dad, let me introduce you, this is my master."
Hearing this, Lin Xuan also nodded towards Wang Fu with a smile on his face.
Wang Fu, on the other hand, was a little flattered by Lin Xuan's smile and quickly returned the favor with fists in his hands.
"Fu Wang, I have met senior."
No wonder he would be like this.
King Realm powerhouses were not something he could come into contact with at all. Although he had seen them, he had never spoken to any King Realm powerhouses, and no King Realm powerhouses had ever looked at him. For such existences, even those in the Tribulation Realm were like ants, not to mention that he was just a mere Tianxuan.
"There is no need for this. Since you are Wang Yan's father, you are one of our own. Come up." Lin Xuan invited.
In this way, Wang Fu took several members of the Wang family who were also in shock and boarded the flying boat.
"You guys come up too."
Just when Qin Han and other members of the adventure group looked envious, Lin Xuan's voice came again.
"Ah? Thank you so much, senior! Thank you so much, senior!"
After collecting the body of the Cloud Shuttle Bird, the flying boat flew away in the air again, speeding towards the Burning Sky Mountain Range.
Lin Xuan has returned to his room for retreat. He can feel that he is very close to understanding the last avenue!
Wang Fu, Wang Yan and others were sitting on the deck, looking at the retreating scenery with deep emotion in their hearts.
There was a time when they were unable to move in the mountains, and they were always worried. They couldn't sleep well at night, and they became extremely nervous at the slightest movement.
Look now...
A long sword suspended above the flying boat exuded extremely terrifying sword intent. It was this sword intent that allowed the flying boat to travel unimpeded along the way. All monsters and beasts avoided it and watched in horror as the flying boat flew past their heads.
This is something that Wang Fu Qingang and other members of the adventure group never dared to think about before.
Any monster below, they had to hide away from when they encountered it before, for fear of provoking each other.
now?
It flew directly over the opponent's head, and the opponent did not dare to make the slightest move.
It's sad.
The interior of the Yingyue Mountains, which is full of dangers, is now like Feizhou's back garden.
"Brother Wang Fu, thanks to you, I, Lao Qin, am also lucky enough to ride on a king-level flying boat, hahaha..." Qin Gang also felt a little emotional.
Two days later, the flying boat arrived at Fentian
